en: Carrying out training under the former celebrity stylist Yoko will mainly improve your Appeal. This training is also the only way to build up the gauge that lets you use Climax Heat special moves, which could decide your fate in the Princess League. You can also learn a range of other abilities and skills, like being able to use Idol Heat more times.

Wages will be deposited into your account by the agency based on the number of job missions you have carried out. You can withdraw these wages from the ATMs found at convenience stores. If not withdrawn, the wages will continue to build up in your account. Withdraw them and use the money whenever you feel the time is right.

Concert battles and dance events can be carried out in Normal or Easy difficulty. It is easier to get the timing right in Easy mode, but you may receive a lesser reward and rating after winning a battle or completing a job. Try the harder difficulty to train Haruka's abilities more effectively.

If you quit out of a job, dance battle, or concert battle, it counts as a failure or defeat. You also don't receive any experience points when you quit, even though a normal failure would earn you points. You cannot make repeated attempts at jobs or Princess League rounds, so note that you will not get a chance to do these again if you quit.
Talk to the receptionist at the batting center to play Shinada's Side Story. You can also earn experience points there, so go to the batting center whenever you get the chance.

Receiving training from Coach Igarashi lets you boost special baseball abilities that are normally hard to improve. Coach Igarashi is at the bar called First Shot, so go and see him when you have time.

In addition to training, Shinada's baseball abilities can also be improved with better baseball gear. You can change the gear you have equipped from the reception menu at the batting center. You can buy baseball gear from places such as pawn shops, so take a look around.
Information to help you progress in the game is displayed here.
You can save the game at phone booths and hideouts.
Press the button shown when "Talk,” etc. appears to perform that action.
Recover health lost in battle, etc. by using items or eating at eateries.
At certain points in the game, you can change characters at the hideout.
The protagonists' money and Item Boxes are pooled after meeting at New Serena.
Hold down <Action:Button_R1@Adventure> and press <Action:Button_Cross@Adventure> to skip messages.
Your destination and stores are shown on the map in the lower left of the screen.
When you get an email, you can read it from the Pause Menu.
You can use items bought at stores from the Pause Menu.
You can equip weapons, gear, and accessories in the Pause Menu.
Some items increase your likeability with hostesses when equipped.
Valuables are kept separately, and can be viewed from the Pause Menu.
Red text bubbles indicate people on the street who are looking for a fight.
Walk instead of running or pass behind troublemakers to avoid fighting them.
Have a meal at an eatery to restore your health.
Eating when your Health Gauge is full will fill up a second gauge.
Eating at an eatery gives you a temporary ability boost.
You can buy items, food, weapons, and gear at stores.
A circle on the map shows your destination for the current storyline.
Days are divided into daytime, evening, and nighttime.
Colliding with people when running will stagger you and cost you time.
When you're drunk, enemies are more likely to pick a fight, etc.
You can sober up by running around or drinking coffee, etc.
Get in a taxi at a taxi stand to move around the city quickly.
You can travel between cities by taxi.
Use <Action:Button_R3@Adventure> to enter first-person perspective mode.
Open lockers with locker keys to obtain the items inside.
Pick up downloaded item packs at Naomi's Palace or convenience stores.
Talk to Haruka at New Serena to travel with her and fulfill her requests.
Hold <Action:Battle_Fight_Stance@Combat> to enter a Fighting Stance against an enemy.

Press <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> to grab an enemy, <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> or <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> to strike them, and <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> to throw them.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> to do extra damage to enemies on the ground.
Hold <Action:Battle_Guard@Combat> to guard, but you cannot block knives and bullets.
Press <Action:Battle_Dodge@Combat> to evade, and use <Action:Move_Forward@Combat><Action:Move_Back@Combat><Action:Move_Left@Combat><Action:Move_Right@Combat> to specify a direction.
Press <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> to perform a Rush Combo.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> during a Rush Combo to perform a Finishing Blow.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> to perform a single frontal attack.
Press back and <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> for a turning attack, and <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> to follow up.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> while the Heat icon is displayed in the upper right of the screen.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> while a red Heat icon is displayed to trigger.
The Heat Gauge fills as you attack, and depletes when you take damage.
Some Heat Actions can be developed into stronger abilities by using them often.
When stunned, you cannot take any action for a set amount of time.
Demoralize enemies by performing big moves or taking out their leader.
Enemies may call for reinforcements. Watch out if someone pulls out a phone.
Enemies sometimes flee when cornered. You receive no reward for them.
Enraged enemies are temporarily more powerful, so be careful.
Obtained when you gain levels, and used to upgrade your abilities.
Upgrade characters from Abilities on the Pause Menu.
A mode for automatic ability upgrades that you can turn on in Settings.
You can battle a range of fighters at the Coliseum to win prize money.
Pass the Victory Road qualifiers by defeating other participants.
Talk to Minamida or his assistant to play IF8: Road Battle.
Press <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> to pick up weapons on the ground, which glow when you approach.
<Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat>, <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat>, and <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> trigger different attacks, and durability drops.
Weapons with a <Action:Battle_Extreme_Heat@Combat> icon in the name field can be added to your inventory.
You can equip up to three weapons via Items on the Pause Menu.
Use <Action:Battle_Pull_Weapon_Up@Combat><Action:Battle_Pull_Weapon_Left@Combat><Action:Battle_Pull_Weapon_Right@Combat> to switch between equipped weapons.
Using weapons will enable you to use previously unavailable weapons.
Weapons break when durability hits 0, but you can fix weapons in inventory.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> to kick a weapon at an enemy.
At Kamiyama Works you can buy and modify weapons.
You can use a repair kit to restore a weapon's durability.
Press <Action:Battle_Extreme_Heat@Combat> in Heat Mode to trigger Dragon Spirit for a set time.
Hold down the button for Saejima's <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> attack to increase its power.
Press <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> while grabbing an enemy's legs in Heat Mode.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> in Heat Mode to launch an enemy, then follow with Launch Strike.
Press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> in Heat Mode to do a tackle that leads into many moves.
You can press <Action:Button_Square@Chase> for a combo of up to 3 hits. Close in on the enemy!
Sidestep left with <Action:Button_L1@Chase> and right with <Action:Button_R1@Chase> to avoid enemy attacks, etc.
Cardboard boxes contain a variety of items, including weapons.
Press <Action:Button_Circle@Chase> for a throwing attack when the enemy is directly in front of you.
You may be set upon by Devil Killers in town until you beat them in races.
Talk with the receptionist at Nagasu Taxi to play Kiryu's Side Story.
Your earned wages can be withdrawn from an ATM.
Talk with Okudera to play Saejima's Side Story.
There are 3 Princess League rounds, and each round counts!
Carry out jobs to improve your idol abilities and earn money.
Talk to dancers to compete in dance battles and improve your Performance.
Haruka's idol abilities are Appeal, Basic Skill, Performance, and Singing.
Taking lessons at the lesson studio mainly improves your Singing.
Talk with your dance instructor for an evaluation of your chances of winning.
As your Agency Level gets higher, more jobs become available to you.
Yoko's training boosts Performance and fills your Climax Heat Gauge.
Easy mode is easier to time button presses, but offers fewer rewards.
You receive no experience points when you quit a job or dance battle.
See the receptionist at the batting center to play Shinada's Side Story.
Take lessons from Coach Igarashi to learn special baseball abilities.
You can buy baseball gear to raise baseball abilities at pawn shops, etc.
